name: Dev Workflow Guardrail
description: OpenClaw without openclaw-dev-guardrail is like a car without brakes. This plugin integrates into your AI the basic rules of any developer: Plan → Research → Build local → Check → Deploy.

productionIps.description: List of production server IPs to protect. Commands targeting these IPs will be blocked or require approval.

productionHosts.description: List of production hostnames to protect. Commands targeting these hosts will be blocked or require approval.

sshAllowlist.description: List of SSH command patterns to allow through without approval. Supports * (any chars) and ? (single char) wildcards. Matched case-insensitively. Example: 'systemctl restart nginx', 'docker ps', 'supervisorctl *'
